description.zh: 用多项式在一点附近逐项贴合 sin x、eˣ、1/(1−x)、ln(1+x)；系数来自各阶导数；收敛半径内加项变准、半径外越加越差；用 eˣ 级数实际算数，并与傅里叶的整体逼近对照。一元实函数模型。
description.en: Match sin x, eˣ, 1/(1−x) and ln(1+x) term by term with polynomials near a point; the coefficients come from derivatives; inside the radius of convergence more terms help, outside they hurt; compute with the eˣ series and contrast with Fourier’s global approximation. A one-real-variable model.

label.zh: 系数 = 各阶导数 ÷ k!

reason.zh: 第 3 步由函数值、斜率、弯曲程度等各阶导数在中心处一致，得到 cₖ = f⁽ᵏ⁾(a)/k!。
reason.en: Step 3 matches the value, slope, curvature and higher derivatives at the centre, giving cₖ = f⁽ᵏ⁾(a)/k!.

label.zh: 局部逼近 vs 整体逼近

reason.zh: 第 5 步对同一函数并排展示泰勒（一点的高阶导数）与傅里叶（整段区间的积分）两种逼近，收敛行为不同。
reason.en: Step 5 shows Taylor (higher derivatives at a point) and Fourier (integrals over a stretch) side by side on one function, with different convergence behaviour.

title.zh: 为什么复杂的函数能被多项式代替？
title.en: Why can a complicated function be replaced by a polynomial?

ask.zh: 系数来自各阶导数——在一点处让多项式和函数各阶导数都相等，近处会贴合吗？
ask.en: Coefficients come from derivatives of each order — matching a polynomial's derivatives to the function's at one point: does it fit nearby?

ask.zh: 收敛半径内加项变准、半径外越加越差——对 ln(1+x)，半径是多少？
ask.en: Inside the radius of convergence more terms mean more accuracy, outside it worse — for ln(1+x), what is the radius?

ask.zh: 泰勒是局部逼近，傅里叶是整体逼近——两者各适合什么场景？
ask.en: Taylor approximates locally, Fourier globally — which scenes suit each?

reveal.zh: 在一点处逐项贴合各阶导数，近处多项式就和函数几乎重合；收敛半径内加项变准，半径外反而变差；傅里叶则是用正弦波在整体上逼近。
reveal.en: Matching derivatives term by term at one point makes the polynomial nearly coincide nearby; inside the radius more terms help, outside they hurt; Fourier instead approximates globally with sine waves.
